title: Molecules
competency: Define molecules and classify molecules of elements and compounds.

keywords.def: The smallest particle of an element or a compound that can exist freely in nature.
A molecule with one atom, like He or Ne.
A molecule with two atoms of the element, like O₂ or H₂.
A molecule of an element with three or more atoms, like O₃, P₄ or S₈.
A molecule with atoms of two or more different elements combined chemically, like H₂O.

en.text: A molecule is the smallest particle of an element or compound that can exist freely in nature. Molecules of elements have one kind of atom: monoatomic (He, Ne), diatomic (O₂, H₂) or polyatomic with three or more atoms (O₃, P₄, S₈).

am.text: ሞለኪውል በተፈጥሮ ራሱን ችሎ ሊገኝ የሚችል የንጥረ ነገር ወይም የውሁድ ትንሹ ቅንጣት ነው። የንጥረ ነገር ሞለኪውሎች ባለ አንድ (He)፣ ባለ ሁለት (O₂) ወይም ባለ ብዙ (O₃) አቶም ናቸው።

screens.title: What does O₂ mean?
screens.ask: Oxygen gas in the air is O₂. What does the small 2 tell you?
opts: There are two kinds of atom
screens.after: Two oxygen atoms are joined together to make one molecule.

screens.title: Figure 2.2: atoms alone, in pairs, in groups
items: Single atoms flying around alone: a monoatomic gas.
Atoms in joined pairs: a diatomic gas.
Three oxygen atoms joined: a polyatomic molecule.

screens.title: Molecules of elements
paras: A molecule of an element has only one type of atom.
Monoatomic molecules have one atom: He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn.
Diatomic molecules have two atoms: O₂, H₂, F₂, Cl₂, I₂.
Polyatomic molecules have three or more atoms: O₃, P₄, S₈.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The smallest particle of an element or a compound that can exist freely in nature.
A molecule with one atom, like He or Ne.
A molecule with two atoms of the element, like O₂ or H₂.
A molecule of an element with three or more atoms, like O₃, P₄ or S₈.

screens.why: Count the atoms: the small number, or 1 if there is none.
screens.clue: Look at the small number after the symbol.

screens.why: O₂ has two atoms. The others have three or more.

screens.ask: A molecule of P₄ has ___ atoms
screens.why: The small 4 means four phosphorus atoms.
Neon exists as single atoms, so it is monoatomic.

screens.text: Ozone (O₃) and oxygen gas (O₂) are both made of oxygen. What is the difference?
opts: O₃ has three atoms per molecule, O₂ has two
screens.ans: O₃ has three atoms per molecule, O₂ has two
screens.why: Both are molecules of the same element, oxygen. They differ only in how many atoms are joined: O₂ is diatomic, O₃ is polyatomic.

en.text: A molecule of a compound contains atoms of two or more different elements joined chemically, like water H₂O, ammonia NH₃ and carbon dioxide CO₂. A molecule of an element has only one kind of atom.

am.text: የውሁድ ሞለኪውል ከሁለት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ የተለያዩ ንጥረ ነገሮች አቶሞች በኬሚካል ተጣምረው የተሠራ ነው፤ ውሃ H₂O፣ አሞኒያ NH₃።

screens.title: Kinds of atom in water
screens.ask: Water is H₂O. How many different KINDS of atom are in it?
screens.after: Two kinds: hydrogen (H) and oxygen (O). That makes water a compound.

screens.title: Molecules of compounds
paras: A molecule of a compound always contains two or more atoms of different elements combined chemically.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A molecule with atoms of two or more different elements combined chemically, like H₂O.

screens.why: Count the kinds of symbol: one kind = element, two or more kinds = compound.
screens.clue: How many different symbols are there?

screens.text: Which is a molecule of an element?
screens.why: H₂ has only hydrogen atoms. The others each have two kinds of atom.

opts: Molecules of compounds have only one type of atom
Molecules of elements have only one type of atom
screens.ans: Molecules of compounds have only one type of atom
screens.why: Molecules of compounds have two or more different types of atom.
screens.clue: Which one describes an element, not a compound?

screens.text: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is a molecule of a compound.
screens.why: It contains carbon and oxygen, two different elements.

screens.text: A molecule has 2 hydrogen atoms and 2 oxygen atoms (H₂O₂). Which is correct?
opts: It is a molecule of a compound with 4 atoms
It is a molecule of an element
screens.ans: It is a molecule of a compound with 4 atoms
screens.why: It has two kinds of atom (H and O), so it is a compound. 2 + 2 = 4 atoms. It is not water, which is H₂O.
screens.clue: How many kinds of atom? How many atoms in total?

opts: The smallest particle of an element or compound that can exist freely
items.ans: The smallest particle of an element or compound that can exist freely
items.clue: It can exist on its own.

items.text: How do you draw a particle model of ozone (O₃)?
items.why: O₃ has three atoms of one element, so the circles are all the same.

test.text: Which is a molecule of a compound?

opts: a diatomic molecule of an element
test.ans: a diatomic molecule of an element

test.text: Which has the MOST atoms in one molecule?
test.why: 8 atoms; NH₃ has 4, O₃ and CO₂ have 3.

notes.text: p.32 defines polyatomic molecules as "more than three atoms", but its own example O₃ has three. The lesson says "three or more atoms".
